account: It is day 0, about 11:07, and I am on my scheduled morning market walk near town hall. The only unusual event I have directly heard is the builder shouting for Freight to wait because the builder needed a private word, around 09:48 near the inn. I also heard Freight shouting in the distance, but could not make out the words. A resident has since repeated the builder's call. I do not know what their business concerns, whether they met, or whether it is urgent; it could simply be a work matter. Several townsfolk report that the baker was carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery. That sounds consistent with ordinary baking supplies, and I have no evidence connecting it to the shouting. The secretary reported no correspondence or urgent business and offered to inquire about the builder and Freight. I attempted to authorize that inquiry, but she was no longer among those who heard my reply, so I cannot assume she received my instructions. I also still need confirmation of the neighbour and exact east-bank dockside cottage for my three o'clock tea. My other appointments today are noon lunch at home, one o'clock town accounts in the office, four-thirty office hours, and seven o'clock home.
